title: Cancel the common payoff
hook: Two stated cases: explore a truly shared outcome in expected-cash arithmetic.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How a truly shared outcome in expected-cash arithmetic affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Advantage, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare a truly shared outcome in expected-cash arithmetic in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy pair shares payoff 80. One adds gain 100 with probability 0.3; the other adds sure 20. What is risky minus sure expected cash?
